# fptcloud_database (Data Source)

Retrieves the detail of a FPT Cloud database cluster by its cluster id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_database" "example" {
  id     = "your_database_cluster_id"
  vpc_id = "your_vpc_id"
}

output "database_status" {
  value = data.fptcloud_database.example.status
}

output "database_endpoint" {
  value = data.fptcloud_database.example.end_point
}

output "database_nodes" {
  value = data.fptcloud_database.example.nodes
}
```

### Lấy IP của từng node

```terraform
data "fptcloud_database" "example" {
  id     = "your_database_cluster_id"
  vpc_id = "your_vpc_id"
}

output "node_ips" {
  value = [for node in data.fptcloud_database.example.nodes : node.ip_address]
}
```

### Đọc cluster vừa được tạo

Node chỉ xuất hiện sau khi cluster provision xong (thường 15–30 phút). Khai báo
`wait_for_nodes_timeout` để chờ thay vì phải chạy lại `terraform` sau đó:

```terraform
resource "fptcloud_database" "example" {
  # ...
}

data "fptcloud_database" "example" {
  id                     = fptcloud_database.example.id
  vpc_id                 = fptcloud_database.example.vpc_id
  wait_for_nodes_timeout = "25m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The Id of the database cluster to look up.

### Optional

- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC Id of the database cluster. Provide it so that the node information is refreshed before the cluster is read.
- `wait_for_nodes_timeout` (String) How long to wait for the nodes of the cluster to become available, as a duration such as "20m". Nodes only exist once the cluster has finished provisioning, so this is what a freshly created cluster needs. Omit it to read the cluster once.

### Read-Only

- `admin_password` (String, Sensitive) The admin password of the database cluster (masked by the API).
- `backup_service_status` (Number) The status of the backup service of the database cluster.
- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the database cluster.
- `created_at` (String) The creation time of the database cluster.
- `data_disk_size` (Number) The size of the data disk in each node of the database cluster.
- `database_name` (String) The name of the default database in the database cluster.
- `edge_gateway_id` (String) The edge gateway Id of the database cluster.
- `edge_id` (String) The edge Id of the database cluster.
- `edition` (String) The edition of the database engine.
- `end_of_support` (String) The end of support date of the running version.
- `end_point` (String) The connection endpoint of the database cluster.
- `engine_active_pitr` (Number) Whether point in time recovery is active (1: true, 0: false).
- `engine_db` (String) The database engine of the database cluster.
- `engine_name` (String) The display name of the database engine.
- `flavor` (String) The flavor name of the database cluster.
- `flavor_id` (String) The flavor Id of the database cluster.
- `ip_public` (String) The public IP of the database cluster.
- `ip_vip` (String) The virtual IP of the database cluster.
- `is_alert` (Boolean) Whether alerting is enabled for the database cluster.
- `is_autoscaling` (Boolean) Whether autoscaling is enabled for the database cluster.
- `is_backup` (Boolean) Whether backup is enabled for the database cluster.
- `is_beta` (Number) Whether the database cluster is a beta product (1: true, 0: false).
- `is_beta_version` (Number) Whether the running version is a beta version (1: true, 0: false).
- `is_cluster` (String) Whether the database is deployed as a cluster (yes/no).
- `is_default_version` (Number) Whether the running version is the default version (1: true, 0: false).
- `is_deprecated_version` (Number) Whether the running version is deprecated (1: true, 0: false).
- `is_eos_version` (Number) Whether the running version reached end of support (1: true, 0: false).
- `is_monitor` (Boolean) Whether monitoring is enabled for the database cluster.
- `is_new_version` (Boolean) Whether the database cluster runs a new version.
- `is_ops` (String) Whether the database runs on OpenStack (yes) or VMware (no)
- `is_public` (String) Whether the database is public or not.
- `limit_disk_size` (Number) The maximum data disk size the database cluster can be scaled up to.
- `list_service` (List of String) The list of services available for the database cluster.
- `master_count` (Number) The number of master nodes in the database cluster.
- `need_reboot` (Boolean) Whether the database cluster needs to be rebooted.
- `need_restart` (Number) Whether the database cluster needs to be restarted (1: true, 0: false).
- `network_id` (String) The network Id of the database cluster.
- `node_core` (Number) The number of cores in each node of the database cluster.
- `node_cpu` (Number) The number of CPUs in each node of the database cluster.
- `node_ram` (Number) The amount of RAM in each node of the database cluster.
- `nodes` (List of Object) The list of nodes (VMs) in the database cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--nodes))
- `nodes_total` (Number) The total number of nodes (VMs) in the database cluster.
- `number_of_shard` (Number) The number of shards in the database cluster.
- `org_name` (String) The organization name of the database cluster.
- `port_db` (String) The port the database is listening on.
- `source_cluster_id` (String) The Id of the cluster this cluster was restored/cloned from.
- `status` (String) The current status of the database cluster.
- `storage_profile` (String) The storage profile of the database cluster.
- `type_config` (String) The type of configuration of the database cluster (short-config or custom-config).
- `type_db` (String) The type of database of the database cluster.
- `vcd_url` (String) The VCD URL of the database cluster.
- `vdc_name` (String) The VDC name of the database cluster.
- `version` (String) The version of the database engine.
- `vhost_name` (String) The name of the RabbitMQ virtual host.
- `vm_network` (String) The VM network of the database cluster.
- `vm_sync` (Boolean) Whether the VM information of the database cluster is synced.
- `worker_count` (Number) The number of worker nodes in the database cluster.
